description: This file is a shell script for testing git p4 interactions, specifically focusing on excluded paths during clone and sync operations within a Perforce and Git integrated environment.

methods.name: start_p4d
methods.description: Starts a local Perforce server for testing.

methods.name: cleanup_git
methods.description: Cleans up the git environment after tests.

methods.name: git p4 clone
methods.description: Clones a Perforce depot into a git repository with specific exclusion options.

methods.name: git p4 sync
methods.description: Synchronizes the git repository with the Perforce depot, respecting exclusions.

methods.name: test_path_is_file
methods.description: Checks whether a specific path exists as a file.

methods.name: test_path_is_missing
methods.description: Checks whether a specific path is missing.
